label: prf:rj-canonical-inner-product
title: Proof of rj canonical inner product
html:
Proof

(i) The Markov trace factors through the Grothendieck ring: \mathrm{tr}_M(a) = \sum_\lambda d_\lambda(q) \cdot \mathrm{tr}_\lambda(a), where \mathrm{tr}_\lambda is the character of irrep \lambda. Restricting to the class functions, spanned by \{\chi_\lambda\}, gives the stated diagonal form.

(ii) The irreps \{\chi_\lambda : \lambda \vdash r\} form an orthogonal basis of the center Z(H_r(q)) under the Markov trace pairing. Schur orthogonality \mathrm{tr}_M(\chi_\lambda \chi_\mu) = d_\lambda \delta_{\lambda\mu} follows from the semisimplicity of H_r(q) for generic q [rosso-jones1993]. Any other bilinear form diagonal in \{\chi_\lambda\} and normalized at the identity differs only by rescaling the Markov parameter z.

(iii) The Rosso–Jones formula [rosso-jones1993] decomposes J(\tau(r,s)) over irreps of H_r(q). Each irrep contributes its quantum dimension d_\lambda(q) multiplied by the s-th power of its full-twist eigenvalue \omega_\lambda. This provides the inner product \langle \omega^s, [\mathrm{triv}] \rangle_{\mathrm{RJ}}, where [\mathrm{triv}] denotes the class of the trivial representation in R(H_r(q)). \square
